szoveg_eredeti:
Users love Multiagent. Usage doubled in just a day. Tasks that break into independent pieces that can run at the same time, like assembling a deck, research from many sources, financial analysis and contact lists are where Multiagent is being sought after by users.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Aravind Srinivas (@AravSrinivas); megjelent: 2026-11-17T16:35:43+00:00; link: https://x.com/AravSrinivas/status/2122730413743567240; média: videó, 41 másodperc]
Introducing Multiagent on Perplexity. Usable with Computer and Teammates (toggle on Effort level). You can have Fable 5.2 orchestrate Gemini 4 Carbon, GPT 6.1 Sol, Opus 5.5 in parallel agent streams to get complex tasks done faster and better (more accurate). A killer for financial research, forecasting, prediction markets, and analyzing a batch of filings together. Available to all Max users on web. Mobile support coming soon.  https://x.com/perplexity_ai/status/2122728603909783741/video/1
